title: Technical Debt Investigator Input Schema
description: Validates orchestrator input context metadata for tech-debt-investigator delegations

context.description: Primary task context from orchestrator (natural language instructions)

execution_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp from orchestrator (mandatory for tracking)

scope.description: Analysis scope definition - directories, patterns, and exclusions

file_patterns.description: Glob patterns for files to include (e.g., ['*.py', '*.md'])

exclusions.description: Glob patterns to exclude from analysis

analysis_type.description: Override auto-detection of analysis mode. See agent docs for mode details.

baseline.description: Previous analysis results for trend comparison (enables iterative mode)

previous_tdr.description: Technical Debt Ratio from previous run (e.g., 0.08 = 8%)

previous_coverage.description: Test coverage percentage from previous run

run_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of baseline analysis for trend delta calculations

previous_category_scores.description: Per-category scores from baseline for granular trend analysis

business_context.description: Business context for prioritization - critical modules and usage patterns

critical_modules.description: Paths to business-critical modules (auth, payments, etc.) for weighted prioritization

usage_frequency.description: Module usage frequency classification for impact weighting

incident_files.description: Files involved in recent incidents (for post-mortem hotspot analysis)

team_ownership.description: Module-to-team mapping for ownership dispersion analysis

additionalProperties.description: Team name owning this module path

thresholds.description: Custom quality gate thresholds (overrides industry defaults)

max_debt_score.description: Maximum acceptable debt_score (fail if exceeded). Default: 60

max_tdr.description: Maximum Technical Debt Ratio (fail if exceeded). Default: 0.10 (10%)

max_complexity.description: Maximum acceptable cyclomatic complexity per function. Default: 10

max_duplication_pct.description: Maximum acceptable code duplication percentage. Default: 5%

hotspot_threshold.description: Hotspot score threshold for urgent flagging. Default: 7.0

regression_tolerance_pct.description: Tolerance for metric regression before flagging (%). Default: 5%

analysis_mode.description: Override auto-detection of analysis mode. Modes: code_debt (packages/tests quality), agent_debt (.claude/agents consistency), comprehensive (full 6-category), historical (git churn analysis), iterative (trend comparison)

output_preferences.description: Customize output format and detail level

include_connection_graph.description: Include debt item relationship graph (adds processing time)

max_hotspots.description: Maximum number of hotspots to report

max_remediation_items.description: Maximum remediation plan items to include

evidence_detail_level.description: Level of evidence detail: minimal (file only), standard (file:line), verbose (file:line + context)

examples.context: Analyze technical debt in packages/. Calculate debt_score, TDR, identify hotspots.
Pre-release quality gate for packages/ and tests/. Flag regressions vs baseline.
Hotspot analysis for packages/api/ after production incident.
